justification: Assessment reports INVALID at step 0016, the claim that every extension sigma' of the prefix sigma_hat = sigma[..i] still violates (P1E&P2E) -> F(P1C|P2C) at i. This is exactly the ground-truth flaw (bad-prefix claim ignores that F depends on the infinite suffix). Its counterexample uses sigma = {P1E,P2E}^omega with i=0 and repairing extension {P1E,P2E}.{P1C}.{}^omega; the ground truth uses sigma = {P1E,P2E}.{}^omega with repair {P1E,P2E}.({P1C})^omega. Both are valid witnesses refuting the same claim: the repairing extension satisfies the implication at i=0 since P1C occurs after the prefix. Same defect, different-but-valid witness.
